source_revision_before_batch_commit: 6edc14e plus local KGP governance projection work
scope: Apply migration 403 to the local Kokonut Kernel candidate after an encrypted PostgreSQL checkpoint and isolated restore rehearsal.

checkpoint.scope_limit: One PostgreSQL database only. Roles/grants, other databases, Docker volumes, external media, and provider state are excluded.

restore_rehearsal.restore_method: age decrypt streamed directly to pg_restore with --exit-on-error --single-transaction --no-owner --no-privileges
restore_rehearsal.entrypoint_race: The first attempt raced the PostGIS image's temporary initialization server; pg_restore's single transaction rolled back. The retry waited for the final PostgreSQL server and restored successfully.

recovery_healthcheck.change: The recovery database healthcheck requires PID 1 to be postgres and a TCP readiness response, so the temporary PostGIS initialization server cannot satisfy readiness.
recovery_healthcheck.disposable_delayed_init_check: During a synthetic 30-second init hook PID 1 was bash, health remained starting, and the healthcheck failed. After initialization PID 1 was postgres, health became healthy, and recent check exit codes were 1,1,1,0.

candidate_rollout.migration_command: python3 -m services.migration migrate --schemas-only --only-migration schema:403_kgp_governance_target_policy_projection.sql --compose-project kokonut-kernel-candidate --compose-file docker-compose.kernel-candidate.yml --compose-file docker-compose.kernel-metabase.yml

limitations: The restore verified schema ledger fingerprints, extensions, and public relation counts, not populated domain-row parity, media, grants, worker leases, or providers.
The candidate app image was not rebuilt or recreated; the rollout applies only the additive, empty governance projection schema.
Migration 403 is an informational mirror. The smart contract remains authoritative for governance policy execution.
This does not establish live RPC behavior, real-chain reorg recovery, application-table RLS, production backup completeness, Raspberry Pi hardware behavior, or long-duration recovery.
